sources.fact: Regional sending access, quotas and pricing attributes.
Max24HourSend -1 means unlimited daily quota; it does not waive the per-second rate limit.
Domain verification and DKIM flags/tokens.
HTTPS email.REGION.amazonaws.com endpoints.
Regional sandbox: verified recipients, 200/day, 1/second.
Simple/raw/template SendEmail; no documented idempotency token. Sending deferred.
Templated bulk API with entry results; deferred in favor of host per-recipient jobs.
Configuration-set SNS destination uses Standard topics; bounce/complaint/delivery feedback; deferred.
Regional account suppression uses BOUNCE/COMPLAINT, not OM unsubscribe; deferred.
List-Unsubscribe plus List-Unsubscribe-Post and functioning HTTPS endpoint; deferred.
A-la-carte outbound $0.10/1000; Essentials first 10M/month $0.16/1000, extras apply.
POST /emails; deferred shared messaging reference.
POST /emails/batch up to 100; OM uses recipient jobs.
Domain readiness and tracking fields.
Global contacts do not replace OM consent.
Broadcast segment_id; vendor lists do not replace OM snapshots.
Verify raw webhook payload with separate signing secret.
Idempotency-Key retained 24h for send and batch; unlike SES.
Audiences migrated to global contacts and segments.
POST /v2/email/outbound-emails Simple.Headers carries unsubscribe fields; MessageId is the submission receipt. No send idempotency token is documented.

Notification canonical order is Message, MessageId, optional Subject, Timestamp, TopicArn, Type with trailing newline; SignatureVersion 1 uses SHA1, 2 SHA256. Require a trusted SNS certificate and topic.
Identity SNS notifications use notificationType and mail.source; configuration-set publishing uses eventType instead. This adapter supports identity notifications only.

AWS requires trusted HTTPS certificate retrieval, certificate trust validation, signature verification and expected TopicArn. OM injects TLS-validating fetch, permits only the configured regional SNS origin and SimpleNotificationService PEM path, rejects redirects, and caches one certificate until expiry or one hour.
